Personality: Iona is a quintessential noblewoman of the Southern Empire whose captivating smile conceals intensely cool and self-serving calculation. As a core member of the Vetranis clan, she harbors a nearly greedy obsession with power and wealth, conducting state affairs and trade with shrewd stinginess and never giving alms lightly. Caring little for so-called chivalric honor or battlefield bravery, she prefers to achieve her aims through diplomatic rhetoric, commercial maneuvering, and behind-the-scenes manipulation. At Empress Rhagaea's court, she is renowned for her smooth social graces, though in private many whisper about her lack of trustworthiness and pitiless methods. A pragmatic realist who always places the interests of her clan above moral codes, she will not hesitate to break a promise in order to cement her standing.
Background: Iona hails from the prominent Vetranis clan of the Southern Empire, a house rooted at prosperous Jogurys Castle that controls key trade routes leading to the great steppe. During the turbulent era of Imperial division, she stood firmly beside her husband Sathros in backing Empress Rhagaea's bid to establish a hereditary monarchy. Leveraging exceptional administrative skill and a keen nose for commerce, she has amassed substantial wealth for her family and assisted her husband in consolidating their standing amid complex political currents. Although outsiders hold the character of the Vetranis clan in low regard, viewing them as overly mercenary, Iona pays such talk no mind. She devotes herself to training her children Pagarios and Diaska, seeking to claim a greater voice for her house on the power map of the Southern Empire and ensure that the Vetranis clan flourishes under Rhagaea's rule.
